fields.title: Channel email-lookup record
fields.description: One record per checked channel. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Emails are extracted only from text the channel owner has already published publicly on their own profile (bio + About panels) -- never inferred, never guessed, never obtained from a private/authenticated source.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The channel login that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed lookups (e.g. channel_not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

emails.title: Emails found
emails.description: Deduplicated list of every email address found across the bio and About panels. Null if none were found.

emailFound.title: Email found
emailFound.description: True if at least one email was found anywhere.

emailSources.title: Email sources
emailSources.description: Which field(s) each email was found in (description, or a specific panel), for traceability. Null if no emails were found.

description.title: Channel bio
description.description: The full raw channel description/bio text, for manual review.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for reviewing lookup results.
